**Freshly invented mob names**

Mobs can now get names nobody has heard before, like Dongik or Kinkleberry, and those names also turn up as makers on gear. Player-like mobs still mostly look like real players. Dyed armour now credits whoever dyed it.

### 0.1866.0

**Echoes inherit your reflexes**

An echo now reacts as quickly as you did in that life. Quick hands leave a quick echo, and a slow life leaves a sluggish one.

- Striking back fast and landing the first hit count most
- Dodging arrows, keeping your hands busy and pushing on down the train count too

**Feedback note fix**

Sending feedback about saving no longer tells you saving is coming. Save and quit is already here.

1.21.1.0.1860.0:
# Sleep Deep. Sleep Safe. Sleep, Save and Quit

![Sleep Deep. Sleep Safe. Sleep, Save and Quit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/save-and-quit.gif)

Its finally here. The most request feature to date.
Train beds now let you save and quit.

Rest in a bed aboard the train and you can step away from the line, then come back to your run where you left it. But be careful where you use a bed! The nether and end are as unforgiving as ever. Saving isn't impossible there, but done differently. So keep your eyes open for ways to give them a rest.

Your Discord profile now shows you're playing Dungeon Train and where you are. Needs the Discord app open on the same computer. Turn it off any time in Options → Account.

### 0.1849.0

**Dimensional carriage editor fix**

Block variants you limit to part of a dimensional carriage now stay out of the rest of it.

**Item fix**

Fixed an item issue in dimensional carriages.

**A new dimensional carriage room**

A new room can now turn up behind a dimensional carriage door. See how far it goes.

While Zombified, your backpack is locked just like the rest of your pack: greyed out, nothing goes in or comes out, and pickups skip it.

**Life as a zombie**

Turning into a zombie changes how you live. You eat like one, read like one and write like one, your pack is out of reach, and villagers, animals, illagers and other players' echoes all treat you like one.

**Trapped chests in the editor**

Chests in the editor can now be set to spawn as trapped chests, anywhere from 0 to 100% of the time. Some chests on the train now come trapped.

Sprint-flying in creative is 3× faster again, and /dt flyspeed changes its speed again. Normal flight and flying up or down are unchanged.

**Answers to your feedback**
